external_collaboration.partner_name: Screen Academy Scotland in Edinburgh/ Napier University
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The programme takes the form of four semesters teaching, along with a summer school. The teaching is unique for a film making MA in that it is split between four different film schools in four different European states: Lusófona University in Lisbon, Portugal, Screen Academy Scotland in Edinburgh/ Napier University, UK, Baltic Film and Media School in Tallinn, Estonia and IADT Dun Laoghaire in Dublin. The teaching in each campus reflects the strengths of the staff and educational history of each
